fields.description: Serro 2 is a collection of three to five bedroom villas at The Heights Country Club and Wellness. Emaar’s design combines white facades, terracotta accents and landscaped outdoor spaces. The setting centres on paths, gardens and shared wellness facilities, with family homes offering more separation from neighbouring residences than an apartment building.

research.community: The Heights Country Club and Wellness
overview: The community brochure places water, walking routes and the wellness centre at the heart of the master plan. Its interior direction uses light neutral colours, natural textures and open living spaces. The shared beach and lake are community facilities; they do not imply that every villa has a waterfront plot or its own pool.
research.locationNote: The Heights is positioned near the junction of Emirates Road (E611) and E77. The community map connects it with Expo City, Al Maktoum International Airport and the wider Dubai road network. Published drive times are marketing estimates and will vary by route and traffic.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Serro 2 from AED 6,000,000. This is an entry-price reference, not a quotation for a specific villa. Plot size, layout, position and release can change the actual asking price.
research.paymentNote: Bayut reports 10% on booking, 70% during construction and 20% at completion. A broker-hosted copy of the Emaar-branded Serro 2 launch sheet gives the milestones below. Several dates have already passed; these document the original schedule and must not be treated as the terms for a new booking.
research.handoverNote: The copied launch sheet targets May 2030 for estimated construction completion; Bayut and Property Finder’s structured fields report Q2 2030. Property Finder’s descriptive text instead says May 2031. Confirm the current contractual completion and handover arrangements with Emaar; construction completion and key handover are not necessarily the same event.
